description: 臺中市消防局列管狹小巷道建議禁止臨停車清冊 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府消防局. 供消防救災車輛通行之道路與通道，臺中市列管狹小巷道建議禁止臨時停車範圍清冊資料，使本市狹小巷道，於平時能符合道路交通管理之需求，並兼顧災害發生時，確保維持消防救災車輛通行之淨寬，俾利救災工作順利遂行，提供清冊，讓民眾了解本市列管狹小巷道列管範圍。. Coverage: 臺中市政府消防局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府消防局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, xml, csv. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
